# Burglar's Pack (`equipment:burglars-pack`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md), [Equipment Packs](../equipment-categories/equipment-packs.md) | **Cost:** 16 gp | **Weight:** 20 lb.
**Contents:** [Backpack](../equipment/backpack.md), [Ball bearings](../equipment/ball-bearings.md), [Bell](../equipment/bell.md), 10x [Candle](../equipment/candle.md), [Crowbar](../equipment/crowbar.md), [Lantern, Hooded](../equipment/lantern-hooded.md), 7x [Flask](../equipment/flask.md), 7x [Oil](../equipment/oil.md), 5x [Rations](../equipment/rations.md), [Rope](../equipment/rope.md), [Tinderbox](../equipment/tinderbox.md), [Waterskin](../equipment/waterskin.md)

A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Ball Bearings, Bell, 10 Candles, Crowbar, Hooded Lantern, 7 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.
